cardOverview.overviewText: A premium lifestyle card that offers high reward rates, luxury travel benefits, milestone vouchers, and lounge access, positioned as Bank of Baroda’s flagship offering.

benefitRows.name: Dining
benefitRows.offer: 250 plus culinary deals at MASTERCARD priceless special.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the dining partner’s app or website using your registered account. Browse available dining and order-in offers, select your favorite meals or restaurants, and apply the benefit at checkout to enjoy exclusive discounts. Complete the payment using your Bank of Baroda Eterna credit card. For assistance, contact Bank of Baroda customer care at 1800 258 4455.

benefitRows.name: District
benefitRows.offer: Buy one and get one on movie tickets booked on District. (max benefit of ₹250/month).
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the District website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.
